sentences.en: A The concept of health holds different meanings for different people and groups.
sentences.zh: 健康的概念对不同的人和群体具有不同的含义。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: These meanings of health have also changed over time.
sentences.zh: 这些健康含义也随着时间的推移而发生变化。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: This change is no more evident than in Western society today, when notions of health and health promotion are being challenged and expanded in new ways.
sentences.zh: 这一变化在西方社会并不比今天更明显,因为当时,健康和促进健康的概念正受到挑战,并以新的方式得到扩展。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: B For much of recent Western history, health has been viewed in the physical sense only.
sentences.zh: B 近代西方历史上,大部分时间只从身体上看待健康。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: That is, good health has been connected to the smooth mechanical operation of the body, while ill health has been attributed to a breakdown in this machine.
sentences.zh: 也就是说,身体的顺利机械操作与身体的健康有关,而身体健康不佳则归因于机器的故障。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Health in this sense has been defined as the absence of disease or illness and is seen in medical terms.
sentences.zh: 从这一意义上讲,健康被定义为没有疾病或疾病,从医学角度来看。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: According to this view, creating health for people means providing medical care to treat or prevent disease and illness.
sentences.zh: 根据这一观点,为人们创造健康意味着提供医疗护理,治疗或预防疾病和疾病。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: During this period, there was an emphasis on providing clean water, improved sanitation and housing.
sentences.zh: 在此期间,重点强调提供清洁饮水、改善环境卫生和住房。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: C In the late 1940s the World Health Organisation challenged this physically and medically oriented view of health.
sentences.zh: C 1940年代末期,世界卫生组织对这种身体和医疗上的健康观提出质疑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: They stated that ‘health is a complete state of physical, mental and social well-being and is not merely the absence of disease’ (WHO, 1946).
sentences.zh: 他们说, " 健康是身体、精神和社会福祉的完整状态,不仅仅是没有疾病 " (卫生组织,1946年)。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Health and the person were seen more holistically (mind/body/spirit) and not just in physical terms.
sentences.zh: 健康和人受到的观察更全面(体力/体力/精神),而不仅仅是身体上的观察。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: D The 1970s was a time of focusing on the prevention of disease and illness by emphasizing the importance of the lifestyle and behaviour of the individual.
sentences.zh: D 1970年代是强调个人生活方式和行为的重要性,注重预防疾病和疾病的时候。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Specific behaviours which were seen to increase risk of disease, such as smoking, lack of fitness and unhealthy eating habits, were targeted.
sentences.zh: 特定行为被视为增加了诸如吸烟、缺乏健身和不健康饮食习惯等疾病风险。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

words.def: 行为行为、行为、行为、行为、行为、行为、

sentences.en: Creating health meant providing not only medical health care, but health promotion programs and policies which would help people maintain healthy behaviours and lifestyles.
sentences.zh: 创造健康不仅意味着提供医疗保健,而且意味着提供健康促进方案和政策,帮助人们保持健康的行为和生活方式。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: While this individualistic healthy lifestyles approach to health worked for some (the wealthy members of society), people experiencing poverty, unemployment, underemployment or little control over the conditions of their daily lives benefited little from this approach.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种个人主义的健康生活方式方法对一些人(社会富裕成员)有效,但穷人、失业、就业不足或几乎无法控制日常生活条件的人从这一方法中受益甚少。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 个人个性主义、个人个性、

sentences.en: This was largely because both the healthy lifestyles approach and the medical approach to health largely ignored the social and environmental conditions affecting the health of people.
sentences.zh: 这主要是因为健康的生活方式方法和医疗方法都在很大程度上忽视了影响人们健康的社会和环境条件。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: E During the 1980s and 1990s there has been a growing swing away from lifestyle risks as the root cause of poor health.
sentences.zh: 在1980年代和1990年代,生活方式风险日益摆脱,成为健康不良的根源。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: While lifestyle factors still remain important, health is being viewed also in terms of the social, economic environmental contexts in which people live.
sentences.zh: 虽然生活方式因素仍然很重要,但人们也从人们生活的社会、经济环境背景来看待健康。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This broad approach to health is called the socio-ecological view of health.
sentences.zh: 这种广泛的保健方法被称为对保健的社会生态观。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

words.def: 社会生态社会 -- -- 社会生态

sentences.en: The broad socio-ecological view of health was endorsed at the first International Conference of Health Promotion held in 1986, Ottawa, Canada, where people from 38 countries agreed and declared that:
sentences.zh: 1986年在加拿大渥太华举行的第一次国际促进健康会议赞同对健康的广泛社会生态观,来自38个国家的人民同意并宣布:

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

words.def: 社会生态社会 -- -- 社会生态

sentences.en: The fundamental conditions and resources for health are peace, shelter, education, food, a viable income, a stable eco-system, sustainable resources, social justice and equity.
sentences.zh: 保健的基本条件和资源是和平、住房、教育、粮食、可行的收入、稳定的生态系统、可持续的资源、社会正义和公平。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Improvement in health requires a secure foundation in these basic requirements. (WHO, 1986)
sentences.zh: 改善卫生状况需要具备满足这些基本要求的可靠基础。 (卫生组织,1986年)

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: It is clear from this statement that the creation of health is about much more than encouraging healthy individual behaviours and lifestyles and providing appropriate medical care.
sentences.zh: 从这一陈述中可以清楚地看出,创造健康不仅仅是鼓励健康的个体行为和生活方式,而且提供适当的医疗。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Therefore, the creation of health must include addressing issues such as poverty, pollution, urbanisation, natural resource depletion, social alienation and poor working conditions.
sentences.zh: 因此,创造健康必须包括解决诸如贫穷、污染、城市化、自然资源耗竭、社会疏远和工作条件差等问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The social, economic and environmental contexts which contribute to the creation of health do not operate separately or independently of each other.
sentences.zh: 有助于创造健康的社会、经济和环境环境并非彼此独立或独立地运作。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Rather, they are interacting and interdependent, and it is the complex interrelationships between them which determine the conditions that promote health.
sentences.zh: 相反,它们是相互作用和相互依存的,决定促进健康的条件的正是它们之间复杂的相互关系。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: A broad socio-ecological view of health suggests that the promotion of health must include a strong social, economic and environmental focus.
sentences.zh: 广泛的社会生态卫生观表明,促进健康必须包括一个强有力的社会、经济和环境重点。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

words.def: 社会生态社会 -- -- 社会生态

sentences.en: F At the Ottawa Conference in 1986, a charter was developed which outlined new directions for health promotion based on the socio-ecological view of health.
sentences.zh: 在1986年渥太华会议上,制定了一个宪章,根据对健康的社会生态观,勾勒出促进健康的新方向。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: This charter, known as the Ottawa Charter for Health Promotion, remains as the backbone of health action today.
sentences.zh: 这一宪章被称为《渥太华健康促进宪章》,今天仍然是卫生行动的支柱。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In exploring the scope of health promotion it states that:
sentences.zh: 在探索促进健康的范围时,它指出:

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Good health is a major resource for social, economic and personal development and an important dimension of quality of life.
sentences.zh: 良好的健康是社会、经济和个人发展的一个主要资源,也是生活质量的一个重要方面。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Political, economic, social, cultural, environmental, behavioural and biological factors can all favour health or be harmful to it. (WHO, 1986)
sentences.zh: 政治、经济、社会、文化、环境、行为和生物因素都可能有利于健康或有害健康(卫生组织,1986年)。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The Ottawa Charter brings practical meaning and action to this broad notion of health promotion.
sentences.zh: 《渥太华宪章》为这一广泛的促进健康概念带来了实际意义和行动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It presents fundamental strategies and approaches in achieving health for all.
sentences.zh: 它提出了实现人人享有健康的基本战略和办法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The overall philosophy of health promotion which guides these fundamental strategies and approaches is one of ‘enabling people to increase control over and to improve their health’ (WHO, 1986).
sentences.zh: 指导这些基本战略和方针的促进健康的总体理念是 " 使人们能够增强对健康的控制并改善其健康 " (卫生组织,1986年)。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

items.prompt: In which year did the World Health Organisation define health in terms of mental, physical and social well-being?
Which members of society benefited most from the healthy lifestyles approach to health?
Name the three broad areas which relate to people’s health, according to the socio-ecological view of health.
During which decade were lifestyle risks seen as the major contributors to poor health?
Doctors have been instrumental in improving living standards in Western society.
The approach to health during the 1970s included the introduction of health awareness programs.
The socio-ecological view of health recognises that lifestyle habits and the provision of adequate health care are critical factors governing health.
The principles of the Ottawa Charter are considered to be out of date in the 1990s.
In recent years a number of additional countries have subscribed to the Ottawa Charter.
